channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: The right and wrong of headlights
item.description: Know when Minnesota law requires headlights and low beams, how far you must see, and what to do about nighttime glare to avoid tickets and crashes.

item.title: Our opinion: PTTP is more than just fundraising
item.description: Austin’s Paint the Town Pink does more than raise money for Hormel Institute cancer research; it depends on dedicated volunteers and local businesses who keep the effort growing.

item.title: MnDOT announces winners of Name a Snowplow contest
item.description: Oh, For Sleet’s Sake and Flurrious George top MnDOT’s latest Name a Snowplow contest, joining six other newly named plows statewide after nearly 19,000 Minnesotans voted.

item.title: 21st annual AAUW assembly is Monday
item.description: Austin High to host AAUW’s 21st Women’s History Month Assembly March 2, featuring winter adventurer and thru-hiker Emily Ford and student history project awards.

item.title: Austin Salvation Army participating in National Food Share Month
item.description: Austin Salvation Army joins National Food Share Month, seeking food and monetary donations as use of its food shelf rises 37.5%, now serving 1,000 households a month.

item.title: With Annunciation families at the Capitol, Democrats unveil gun violence prevention bills
item.description: After a deadly church shooting, Annunciation students join DFL lawmakers at the Minnesota Capitol as Democrats propose 15 gun violence prevention bills and Republicans push alternatives.

item.title: Seniors lead the way as Hayfield/Schaeffer Academy rallies past Burros
item.description: Seniors Lily Morrisey, Avi Alexander and Maggie Hansen spark No. 2 Hayfield/Schaeffer Academy’s 74-59 Section 1A comeback over Lanesboro after an early hole and recent loss.

item.title: PRC program seeks to coordinate resources and guidance for parents
item.description: PRC's Diane Whalen is guiding the development of a program geared toward the success of the family unit.

item.title: Rebels rally from 20-point deficit to advance to Section 1A semis
item.description: Southland girls erase 20-point deficit at Mayo Civic Center, beating Fillmore Central 73-65 to advance to the Section 1A semifinals against No. 2 Hayfield/Schaeffer Academy.

item.title: Packer boys crush Winhawks
item.description: Austin defeats Winona 80-54 behind Xzayveun Severin’s six threes and 32 points, moving the Packers to 13-10 overall.
